pilgrims_of_the_slag.letter: Brother Oto says the dust is a verdict. Please file your own.
pilgrims_of_the_slag.prayer: He is singing to the slag. The slag is listening.

let.text: Brother Oto prays at the dump. The next wave will be late and will be there. This is not a favor.

silence.text: The prayer was ended. Morale notes the ending.

join.text: A second pilgrim has joined the singing. Output is reduced. The creatures are slightly confused.

options.label: Let him pray
options.hint: Next wave is late. He may die.

pilgrims_of_the_slag.title: Pilgrims of the Slag
